title: Python itertools By Example
description: Master Python's itertools module by building practical examples with batched(), pairwise(), groupby(), and more, and learn to think iteratively.
summary: It has been called a “gem” and “pretty much the coolest thing ever,” and if you haven’t heard of it, then you’re missing out on one of the greatest corners of the Python standard library : itertools . Knowing the definitions of its functions isn’t enough, though.
takeaways: The real power of Python’s itertools lies in composing those functions into fast, memory-efficient, and good-looking code.
Real Python’s Intermediate Python Deep Dive live course takes you through the object model, decorators, and other patterns that experienced Python developers rely on.
A handful of excellent resources exist for learning what functions are available in the itertools module .
